purpose: Close the declared 18-domain B-BIGPIC-01 evidence/coverage gate by consuming the authorized BIG09/BIG13 recovery returns while preserving original attempts and authority separation. This closes the architecture-coverage gate; it does not by itself promote product/method authority.

consumed_new_evidence.late_original_rule: RUN-BIG-09-A remains preserved. If a later original return appears, reopen only affected reconciliation scope and consume both; newest-wins is forbidden.

consumed_new_evidence.theme: Goldens + Vaccines + incidents + negative phenotypes + chaos/falsification
consumed_new_evidence.late_original_rule: RUN-BIG-13-A remains preserved. If a later original return appears, reopen only affected reconciliation scope and consume both; newest-wins is forbidden.

finalized_decisions.decision: Convergence uses immutable RETURN evidence -> semantic atoms -> scoped authority-aware clusters -> contradiction graph -> coverage audit -> one owning Steward/Merger adjudication -> append-only consumption/integration ledger -> separately authorized promotion/mutation -> post-write verification. Consumption is not acceptance; acceptance is not Current; Current is not Served.

The learning plane distinguishes INCIDENT, NEGATIVE_PHENOTYPE, VACCINE, GOLDEN, FALSIFICATION_CASE and compiled REGRESSION_SUITE. Source observations stay immutable; normalized learning is lineaged; prevention/reference promotion is evidence-, scope- and authority-gated; every promoted prevention needs a falsifier; recurrence reopens prevention rather than hiding failure.

steward_contract.consumption_ledger: append-only, scope-aware, idempotent by integration batch + return hash + scope
steward_contract.conflict_policy: semantic duplicate may merge lineage; same-scope contradiction blocks affected decision until discriminating evidence/falsification or genuine human boundary; partial-scope conflicts are split, not globally accepted/rejected
steward_contract.ownership: one active steward owns one overlapping integration domain/generation; disjoint domains may converge in parallel
steward_contract.promotion: steward can prepare candidate decisions but cannot manufacture Human Accepted/Current/Served authority
steward_contract.currentness: important mutations require re-fetch + CAS/current-owner check
steward_contract.rollback: forward decision selecting a confirmed donor/base while preserving all newer history and receipts
steward_contract.late_return: reopen affected scope as a new decision revision; preserve prior evidence and decision lineage

learning_plane_contract.incident: immutable observed expectation-vs-reality record with evidence and authority stage
learning_plane_contract.negative_phenotype: reusable trigger + observable signature + violated invariant, independent of one root-cause hypothesis
learning_plane_contract.vaccine: scoped prevention/detection/recovery candidate; ACTIVE only after prevention + negative-control/falsifier + preserve/regression evidence + owning integration receipt
learning_plane_contract.golden: verified bounded positive reference behavior/artifact; not product authority by itself
learning_plane_contract.falsification_case: replayable adversarial case that distinguishes presence from breakage/removal of the protected invariant
learning_plane_contract.regression_suite: compiled projection selecting applicable Goldens/Vaccines/Falsifiers by task/scope, not a copy of all learning artifacts
learning_plane_contract.recurrence_rule: failure recurrence after an ACTIVE vaccine reopens the incident/phenotype and prevention confidence

coverage_audit.historical_source_debt: Literal older R-era/FABRIC/Prompt-OS source coverage remains incomplete and must be handled by the already-prepared historical concept-ledger opportunity. This debt does not reopen the declared 18-domain scout coverage gate, but it blocks claims of exhaustive historical closure.
coverage_audit.authority_audit: No worker return or this integration is treated as Human Accepted, Current or Served. Architecture/Active Method outputs remain candidates pending explicit promotion path and falsification/canaries.

preserved_tensions: Recovery returns may later coexist with original WI-BIG-09/WI-BIG-13 returns and must be reconciled rather than newest-wins.
Context/learning/method projections must never replace source evidence or authority heads.
Deep worker continuation improves throughput only when independence/authority/failure-isolation constraints remain satisfied.

next_system_gate: Move from architecture coverage to demonstrated recursive metabolism: verification of current swarm, Planner->Queue generation N+1, context receipts/Context Fabric canary, stale/retry design, event-loop design and production /w gates.
